Specifications.Weight: 37 oz (1049 grams) Actual size and weight may vary by manufacturing process.
Specifications.Wifi connectivity: Wifi 6E (802.1ax) is supported. Tri-band, wifi (SISO). Supports 802.11a/b/g/n/ac wifi networks. Does not support connecting to ad-hoc wifi networks.
Specifications.Sensors: Ambient Temperature Sensor, Ambient Light Sensor, Presence Detection, Camera
Specifications.Omnisense technology: Omnisense technology is a custom technology built for ambient AI to deliver more proactive and personalized experiences. Omnisense enables capabilities such as visual ID, proximity and presence detection, temperature sensing, and adaptive brightness and color.
Specifications.System requirements: Echo Show 8 comes ready to connect to your wifi. The Alexa app is compatible with Fire OS, Android, and iOS devices and also accessible via your web browser
Specifications.Setup requirements:
Amazon Wi-Fi simple setup enables customers to connect smart devices to their wifi network in a few easy steps. Wi-Fi simple setup is another way Alexa is always getting smarter.

Specifications.Included in the box: Echo Show 8 (2025 release), power adapter (30W), and quick start guide.
